name: Brine Automaton
method: Direct visual inspection of four references; framing validation is not mechanical consistency approval.
confirmed: Copper barrel, verdigris, brass, salt, piston limbs and gauge eyes preserved.
Rear replaces eyes and belly wheel with tank straps and maintenance hatch.
Profiles point opposite directions with tank behind torso and toes facing forward.
limitations: Side valve stems appear at different heights despite front paired level layout; must align fixed mount positions.
Side knee plates retain frontal appearance; define hinge axes and distinguish near/far legs.
Rear clamp hands resemble front-facing fingers; finger curvature needs construction review.
Tank depth and gauge face exposure in profiles need strict orthographic alignment.
Top valve margins are tight; normalize framing before animation.
Salt and rivet patterns vary; fixed surface landmark map pending.
next: Correct mechanical axes, tank and valve mounts and hand orientation, then normalize, separate rigid parts and animate. Steam should be runtime VFX.
